# wowsims links (12 November 2026, evening)

The final set of each spec, with enchants and consumables (the "Both" column of README.md). The full wowsims test raid buffs and debuffs, a level 63 boss, 2 min. Open a link, then select Simulate. The DPS values come from wowsims master commit `129fcd89e` (12 November 2026, evening). A later wowsims version can give a different DPS.

| Spec | DPS (129fcd89e) | Link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fury Warrior | 900.3 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warrior/dps/#) |
| Demonology Warlock | 942.7 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps/#) |
| Hunter | 925.2 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/hunter/dps/#) |
| Fire Mage | 917.8 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps/#) |
| Combat Rogue | 754.1 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/rogue/dps/#) |
| Retribution | 837.8 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/paladin/retribution/#) |

`zzlink_main.go` makes these links (copy to `cmd/zzlink/main.go`). It also decodes each link and runs it again as a check. The check on commit 129fcd89e gives the same values ±0.2%.

The links of 12 November (commit 52471a100) had the sets of `sets_52471a100/`. The search of 12 November, evening, changed the sets of Fury, Combat Rogue, Hunter and Retribution. The Fire Mage and Demonology Warlock sets do not change (README.md).

The links of 11 November (commit 3633d376a) had the sets of `sets_3633d376a/`. The search of 12 November changed the sets of Fury, Combat Rogue, Hunter, Demonology Warlock and Retribution. The Fire Mage set does not change (README.md).

The links of 9 November (commit 9f254e8d8) had the sets of `sets_9f254e8d8/`. The search of 11 November changed the sets of the five pure specs. The Retribution set does not change (README.md).

The links of 8 November (commit ae9b8c23a) had the sets of `sets_ae9b8c23a/`. The search of 9 November changed the sets of the five pure specs. The Retribution set does not change (README.md).

The links of 6 November (commit df57e2571) had the sets of `sets_df57e2571/`. The search of 8 November changed the sets of all six specs (README.md).

The links of 4 November (commit 8298ab833) had the sets of `sets_9a8624af9/`. The search of 6 November changed the sets of the five pure specs (README.md).

The links of 2 November (commit 895cd67f9) had the same items. Only the consumables changed: the shared elixir list takes the elixirs of the new Warlock preset.
- **Short links.** `sets/` at the root of the repository has one page for each set. Each page opens the wowsims link: https://ralgathor.github.io/forever-paladin-feedback/sets/
